agreements: The core experiment should remain exactly two primary on-policy systems, HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL, with a shared frozen model, packet, public stores, task schedule, logical budgets, clock, reset policy, and deterministic SLEEP cadence. Adapter-off, preservation-only, and binding-shuffled conditions may be sterile checkpoint evaluations only; they must never become additional acquiring agents or a factorial pilot.

A valid HARNESS-versus-EXPERIENTIAL comparison requires matched sealed held-out evaluation for both primary systems at the declared checkpoints. The comparison is not supplied by EXPERIENTIAL authentic-versus-off forks alone.

Stage C can be a one-paired-life wiring and feasibility assay with raw descriptive reporting. It cannot estimate an arm effect, counterbalance order, establish a causal mechanism, validate outcome credit, or support a population, lifetime, saturation, superiority, or paper claim.

The post-selection binding shuffle is useful only as a state-to-operation binding diagnostic. It preserves outcome-conditioned selection and therefore cannot identify the necessity or correctness of outcome-based credit selection.

Official CompilerGym 0.2.5, LLVM 10, and POJ104-v1 remain conditional candidate bytes. Static identity, offline semantics, a mechanically sealed public split, and target-blind transfer/headroom checks must fail terminally rather than authorize patching, downloading, substitution, tuning, or a different substrate.

Before any scoped implementation, the revised proposal must distinguish architecture specification, non-executing static inspection, fixture/test implementation, and executable runner/trainer work, with a separate bound authorization for each material transition.

Before Stage C, one run manifest must bind parser and packet bytes, state allowlist, visibility channels, reward identifier and score formula, invalid-cell rule, split/relation/headroom construction, seed and determinism scope, resource ledgers, and all sterile-fork construction rules before targets are opened.

Private rationale, self-report, explanatory prose, and human-theory similarity remain forbidden targets and endpoints. Any loss-bearing focus field must be a finite typed operational label with an enumerated token-level mask, not a route for self-authored rationale.

Stage D remains separately proposed, independently reviewed, and human-ratified work. It—not Stage C—must contain fresh tasks, independent paired lives, a life-level analysis plan, and stronger external-memory and transport controls before paper-level or broad comparative claims.

disagreements.issue: Whether the advertised two-agent comparison is operationally simple and whether its held-out HARNESS-versus-EXPERIENTIAL estimand is actually executed.

positions.position: Use exactly two primary acquiring agents, but evaluate only experiential authentic, adapter-off, and final shuffled checkpoint forks.
Retain two primary systems but add matched HARNESS target evaluation and name its primary contrast; do not infer component causality from the aggregate two-call loop.

resolution.rationale: Two acquiring systems are sufficient for a bounded whole-system comparison, but no HARNESS target measurements means that comparison is absent. Adding matched HARNESS sterile evaluation is necessary measurement, not a new on-policy arm or causal factorial.
resolution.selected_position: The revised Stage C must run only HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL on policy, on the same frozen acquisition schedule and declared per-call seed-stream policy. At checkpoints 0, 4, and 8, each system receives matched sealed target evaluation descendants under the same packet, budget, scoring, and quarantine rules. The primary Stage-C descriptive contrast is the matched checkpoint-specific HARNESS-versus-EXPERIENTIAL held-out score; EXPERIENTIAL authentic-versus-adapter-off, preservation-only, and final binding-shuffled descendants are secondary diagnostics. The report must say that the whole-system contrast does not isolate ORIENT, retrieval, action, compiler, or adapter components.
resolution.required_change: Rewrite the checkpoint graph, visibility matrix, T04, T08, and T09 to include HARNESS target forks and the exact primary descriptive contrast, while preserving exactly two on-policy systems and forbidding a factorial acquisition design.

disagreements.issue: What a one paired life can establish, and whether opposite task orders are counterbalancing.

positions.position: Call Stage C a counterbalanced paired non-claim mechanism pilot.
One pair cannot counterbalance arm, order, sampling, or training realization and can support only a descriptive wiring result.

resolution.rationale: Repeated targets and checkpoints are nested within one realization, not independent lives. Opposite orders confound order with arm; one pair cannot resolve that confounding.
resolution.selected_position: Use one common locked acquisition order for both systems in Stage C (or explicitly label any order difference as an unresolvable descriptive design choice), bind inference and trainer seed streams, and report every raw cell and failure. Stage C may only establish that this exact wiring was or was not feasible under its frozen bytes. It may motivate, but not constitute, a replicated mechanism study. Stage D must predeclare fresh tasks, multiple independent paired lives, life-level uncertainty, and order handling before any directional or paper interpretation.
resolution.required_change: Remove counterbalancing and one-life mechanism-effect language from the change; replace it with a fixed descriptive feasibility contract and a separate Stage-D inference plan.

disagreements.issue: Whether deterministic outcome-filtered rows and a post-selection shuffle identify causally correct outcome credit.

positions.position: Treat deterministic outcome-grounded compilation plus shuffled binding loss as a mechanism observation.
The chosen post-selection shuffle tests useful state-to-operation binding, not outcome-conditioned selection.
Require more outcome/credit evidence before using outcome-grounded causal language.

resolution.rationale: Determinism makes the heuristic replayable, while selected-row-preserving derangement leaves the outcome-conditioned selection pathway unchanged. Neither is causal validation of the credit heuristic.
resolution.selected_position: Retain the simple deterministic compiler and post-selection shuffle for the first pilot, but call rows outcome-filtered rather than causally outcome-grounded. T09 may test only state-to-operation binding after a measured semantic disruption check. No pre-selection outcome-ablation factorial is required in Stage C. Any claim that outcomes selected the useful rows, or that the credit rule is causal, is deferred to a separately ratified study with a directly appropriate intervention.
resolution.required_change: Narrow V6_CLAIM_MECHANISM_ONLY, T02, T09, and all report language; bind semantic action/focus equivalence classes, a minimum disruption criterion, and terminal failure if a valid derangement cannot break the declared binding.

disagreements.issue: Whether adapter-off isolates experience rows and whether the fixed LoRA recipe has a non-target viability contract.

positions.position: Compare authentic adapter with a null adapter and use a tiny synthetic/cached canary for mounting.
Preservation updates confound authentic-versus-off, and synthetic mounting does not establish actual-row fitness.

resolution.rationale: A null adapter lacks both outcome-filtered rows and preservation updates, so it cannot attribute a difference to experience rows alone. A fixed recipe can be screened without tuning or target access.
resolution.selected_position: At every experiential checkpoint compare authentic with both adapter-off and a sterile preservation-only adapter trained with the identical base, anchors, stack, update budget, and optimizer lifecycle but no acquisition-derived rows. Before targets open, the Stage-B canary must use sealed acquisition-only public rows to verify a predeclared nondegenerate fit criterion, cold-load behavior, numerical status, and schema preservation. It is one fixed recipe: failure is terminal for this change and never authorizes a sweep or tuning.
resolution.required_change: Add preservation-only sterile forks, exact anchor/update accounting, and an acquisition-only fixed-recipe row-fit gate to T02, T07, T09, and T10.

disagreements.issue: Whether the official substrate, split, primary score, margin, and resource accounting are executable and informative enough for the pilot.

positions.position: Use official IrInstructionCount/normalized-baseline reward and an 8/4 related-nonduplicate POJ104 split, with margin later derived from the canary.

Bind one reward formula, score and missing-cell rule; mechanically establish both nonduplication and positive public relatedness/headroom before model calls; retain logical and physical resource ledgers.

resolution.rationale: A slash is not a metric. Neighbor exclusion alone does not show transfer opportunity, and logical parity alone does not describe unequal compute or transport cost.
resolution.selected_position: A pre-target manifest must name exactly one official reward-space identifier, direction, baseline source, correctness gate, score formula, epsilon, timeout/invalid rule, target weighting, checkpoint summary, missing-cell handling, and primary descriptive contrast. It must mechanically freeze public feature extraction, relation strata, thresholds, duplicate/near-neighbor exclusion, spare candidates, and a target-blind positive headroom diagnostic. Report both a model-visible parity ledger and an offline total-resource ledger, including adapter/training/retrieval/compiler/wall/peak-memory costs without padding useful information. T05/T06 rejection remains terminal if unchanged local bytes cannot support the contract.
resolution.required_change: Replace the reward slash, metric menu, and prose split with a hash-bound executable score/split/resource specification required before Stage C target opening.

disagreements.issue: How source persistence, visibility cells, determinism, and authorization order are made internally consistent.

positions.position: Only the adapter persists across sleep, composite visibility cells summarize allowed/forbidden state, and several executable tests are required before implementation.

Separate nonparametric source/audit persistence from adaptive state; atomize visibility channels; distinguish manifest determinism from training reproducibility; and authorize static/design work separately from executable implementation.

resolution.rationale: The cumulative compiler needs persistent sealed source records, composites hide opposite permissions, and no executable invariant can be verified before the permitted artifact class is defined.
resolution.selected_position: Within a life, sealed ledger/notebook/immutable receipts persist as nonparametric source evidence; only the declared treatment adapter is adaptive parameter state across sleep; trainer, optimizer, cache, process, and task workspace are destroyed at the declared boundaries. Replace every composite visibility item with atomic channels and exact readers/writers. Bind canonical serialization, token masks, parser failure charging, model/training stack identity, and which properties require byte identity, same-platform numerical tolerance, or behavioral cold-load equivalence. A revised transition plan must separately authorize non-executing static inspection, design/fixture implementation, executable CPU harness work, offline install, hardware canary, and Stage C run.
resolution.required_change: Rewrite T01-T05 and T12 with the atomized state/visibility allowlist, determinism tiers, and an explicit scoped-implementation authorization sequence; do not infer authority from architecture ratification.

disagreements.issue: How to keep typed focus from becoming self-authored rationale training and how far HARNESS parity can be interpreted.

positions.position: Typed focus may be loss-bearing and shared notebook/retriever supplies strong full-harness parity.
Allow only finite operational focus labels in the loss mask and describe parity as the declared harness, not a strong external-memory baseline suite.

resolution.rationale: Unenumerated typed text can carry rationale content, and one bounded notebook/retriever is a credible parity control without representing all ordinary-memory agents.
resolution.selected_position: The revised schema must enumerate retained focus fields and exact targetable finite labels; reason, strategy, active question, uncertainty, expected-effect prose, hypotheses, and all free text are input/provenance only with zero loss mask. Stage C may claim parity only within the declared common notebook/ledger retriever. Same-corpus text, organized-memory, raw-LoRA, wrong-life, and other transport comparisons remain Stage-D controls.
resolution.required_change: Bind a token-level focus/operation mask audit and replace broad baseline wording with declared-harness parity wording.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The two-system acquisition core is worth preserving, but it cannot identify the many internal components.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Call it a two-system whole-harness assay and prohibit component-causal interpretations; do not add an on-policy factorial.

concern_dispositions.rationale: No target fork for HARNESS means the named primary comparison is not measured.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add matched HARNESS checkpoint target forks and primary descriptive contrast.

concern_dispositions.rationale: One pair cannot separate life-level stochasticity or order from arm.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use a common locked order and descriptive reporting only; defer inference to independent Stage-D lives.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Shared bounded memory is credible within-harness parity but not the promised broad comparator suite.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Narrow Stage-C baseline language and defer stronger memory transports to Stage D.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Reproducibility does not validate the temporal credit heuristic.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Describe rows as deterministic outcome-filtered supervision and forbid causal-credit claims.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The selected-row-preserving shuffle leaves outcome selection intact.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Limit shuffle interpretation to state-operation binding; defer outcome-selection tests.

concern_dispositions.rationale: ID-level derangement can retain equivalent operations.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind semantic equivalence classes, disruption rate, and terminal construction failure.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Adapter-off omits preservation updates as well as experience rows.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add preservation-only sterile adapter control with identical anchors and update accounting.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Synthetic mounting does not show nondegenerate learning on public acquisition rows.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a fixed-recipe acquisition-only row-fit gate with no sweep or tuning.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The proposal has no single score, contrast, or margin rule.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind one official reward/score specification and all cell, weighting, and margin rules before target opening.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Nonduplication alone does not show related, learnable transfer opportunity.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind public relation strata, thresholds, spares, and target-blind headroom diagnostic.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The current required-before labels conflict with the forbidden implementation scope.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Separate non-executing inspection, fixture work, executable implementation, and later run authorizations.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Cumulative rebuilding needs sealed records after sleep.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Classify persistent source/audit records separately from adaptive and ephemeral state.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A composite cell cannot prove per-channel isolation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Atomize channels and readers/writers in the matrix and tests.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Typed focus may otherwise hide loss-bearing explanatory prose.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Enumerate finite target labels and token masks; hard-mask all rationale-like fields.

concern_dispositions.rationale: One life cannot convert its checks into mechanism evidence.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Make Stage C a wiring/feasibility result only and reserve mechanism language for replicated work.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Compilation determinism and accelerator-training reproducibility are distinct guarantees.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind software/hardware scope and separate byte, tolerance, and behavioral reproducibility assertions.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: The proposed literal wording contradicts cumulative compilation.
Execution-defining bytes cannot be inferred after authorization.
One reward space and score conversion are required.
POJ104 remains an unverified candidate until static and semantic gates pass.
The one-life design has no life-level replication or comparator suite.
Exclusion proves only nonduplication, not useful relatedness.
Logical parity and offline physical cost answer different questions.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Must test atomized packet/state/visibility channels, finite loss-bearing labels, and two-system scope without claiming component identification.
Must distinguish deterministic outcome-filtered compilation from causal credit, bind semantic shuffle disruption, anchor accounting, and determinism tiers.
Must permit sealed source/audit records across sleep while destroying adaptive ephemeral state and specify behavioral versus byte reproducibility.
Must use atomized channels and cover matched HARNESS plus all sterile target descendants.
Must bind exactly one candidate reward identity and mechanical public relation/split construction, while remaining non-executing and terminal on failure.
Must bind clean-process replay, invalid/timeout mapping, cache policy, one score formula, and pre-model target sealing.
Must use acquisition-only public rows to test the one frozen recipe, fit criterion, resource accounting, and margin procedure without a tune loop or target access.
Must lock common order/seed policy, evaluate both primary systems on matched targets, name one descriptive contrast, and prohibit mechanism/effect language.
Must add preservation-only control and restrict authentic/off/shuffle results to sterile diagnostics, with shuffle testing state-operation binding only.
Must audit token-level masks, semantic-neighbor reuse, preservation-only effects, and schema/style drift before any allowed descriptive wording.
Must explicitly require life-level units, independent paired lives, strong memory/transport controls, and a new intake rather than treating Stage C as a mechanism precursor.
Must review an exact revised change and transition-specific authorization manifest before each static, executable, hardware, Stage-C, and claim step.

questions: Do you direct a reworked, newly hash-bound proposal rather than implementation of these frozen bytes: retain exactly two primary on-policy systems but add matched HARNESS held-out descendants, one common Stage-C acquisition order, and descriptive wiring-only reporting?

Do you require the rework to bind the source-versus-adaptive-state lifecycle, atomized visibility matrix, parser and token masks, determinism tiers, one official score, public split/relatedness/headroom contract, preservation-only adapter control, and transition-specific authorization before any scoped implementation?

Do you confirm that Stage C may not make mechanism, outcome-credit, effect, lifetime, baseline-superiority, or paper claims, and that any such claims require a separate Stage-D intake with independent paired lives and stronger controls?
